M-FILE.NAME: File-local markup view
M-FILE.purpose: Show file-local semantic markup: MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, CHANGE_SUMMARY, function contracts and block integrity.

CrossLink.relation: shares analyzeMarkup so lint and file show cannot disagree

contract.purpose: Show file-local semantic markup: MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, CHANGE_SUMMARY, function contracts and block integrity.

param.name: path
param.description: File path relative to --root (absolute paths win).

param.name: text
param.description: Extracted markup sections and block pairing diagnostics.

error.description: Missing file path or unreadable file (exit 2).

notes.note-1: Block pairing printed here is name-aware, matching lint exactly.
notes.note-2: Legacy === MODULE_CONTRACT === markers are still recognized for older files.
